config.label: Base URL of the Proctor gate
config.description: Base URL of the Proctor gate. Defaults to http://localhost:3700.

config.label: Hedera account id of the paying agent, e
config.description: Hedera account id of the paying agent, e.g. 0.0.12345. Set this with HEDERA_AGENT_KEY to settle a real x402 payment. Omit both and the tool falls back to Proctor's operator endpoint, which opens a real decision but settles nothing.

config.label: ECDSA private key for HEDERA_AGENT_ID
config.description: ECDSA private key for HEDERA_AGENT_ID. Spends money: scope it to a funded testnet account and nothing else.

config.label: Comma-separated HTS token ids this agent may pay in
config.description: Comma-separated HTS token ids this agent may pay in. The agent's own guard: it refuses assets its operator never approved.
